explication: DBeaver is a Java/Eclipse desktop database client. Its user-facing work centers on connecting to a database, exploring and editing data or SQL, and executing database operations; it also supports data movement, object comparison, and spatial viewing. The supplied tree samples only parts of this larger product: Query Manager and SQL editor handlers, PostgreSQL view management, and GIS components provide clearer internal detail than most other capabilities. Several README-documented branches are represented at their listed subsystem paths, but their internal wiring is not inferred.
